text: As requested by the Board of Directors at its April 27, 2026 meeting, this report presents the updated 2026 annual objectives for the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, incorporating targets, timelines and/or metrics to evaluate their achievement.

The Board of Directors, CreateTO: 1. Approved the updated 2026 annual objectives for the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO as detailed in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 5, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO. 2. Directed that the information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 5, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO remain confidential in its entirety, as it deals with personal matters about an identifiable person and with a proposed or pending acquisition or disposition of land by the Board of Directors, CreateTO.
